source: David Tom Foss Hugging Face CPU-basic actual-model consumer-sensitive temporal quantization experiment, 2026-11-06
quantizer: global per-coordinate Viterbi over ternary codes
objective: downstream diagonal linear sensitivity times squared distortion plus transition penalty

mlp_layer_7.interpretation: For this measured trajectory, one temporally stable code per coordinate produced lower downstream projection MSE than independent nearest-code quantization while eliminating all code events.

conclusion: Quantization must be optimized against the actual downstream consumer and event cost. Raw activation MSE is not a reliable proxy: it can rank code trajectories opposite to their projection error and temporal compute cost.
